left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Presence of post-stroke aphasia
  -  Single left hemisphere stroke etiology
  -  At least 6 months post-stroke
  -  Age range between 18 and 80 years old
  -  Speak English as a native language
  -  Adequate hearing  [AND] and vision to complete the tasks
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Severe auditory comprehension deficits (determined by pretest) (i

, global aphasia, [OR]  Wernicke's aphasia, [OR]  transcortical sensory aphasia)
  -  Inability to provide informed consent
  -  Co-occurring history of neurological disease/ [OR] disorder/ [OR] injury (e

, traumatic brain injury, right hemisphere stroke, [OR]  dementia)
  -  Co-occurring history of a major mental illness (e

, schizophrenia, [OR]  drug addiction, [OR]  bipolar)
  -  Clinical conditions contraindicated for MRI  [OR] or tDCS (e

right.raw_text:
, implanted electrical devices, [OR]  claustrophobia, [OR]  seizure disorder)
  -  Positive pregnancy test (for females)
